title: Re-blessed file set does not match the claimed chunk contents: demolish/demolish_bundle/audio_throttle absent, place/router_ceiling/router_tiers present instead
evidence: Claimed: "This chunk contains the remaining re-blessed .t1 goldens (ecmp, demolish, demolish_bundle, audio_throttle, bundle, lose, win, flow, draw, forecast_shift, ecmp_cost), whole."  Diff actually contains: "diff --git a/goldens/place.t1 b/goldens/place.t1", "diff --git a/goldens/router_ceiling.t1 b/goldens/router_ceiling.t1", "diff --git a/goldens/router_tiers.t1 b/goldens/router_tiers.t1" — and contains no "diff --git a/goldens/demolish.t1", "diff --git a/goldens/demolish_bundle.t1", or "diff --git a/goldens/audio_throttle.t1".
detail: Three claimed goldens were not re-blessed here while three unclaimed ones were. If demolish/demolish_bundle/audio_throttle still pin the old catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860, they will mismatch the new catalog and fail.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the chunk: either re-bless demolish/demolish_bundle/audio_throttle (catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860 -> 17d3baf8c6e1df7f) or correct the chunk description to list place/router_ceiling/router_tiers.
